# Codespace continuation index

This is an operational index for the existing product and its committed work, not another policy or roadmap.

Repository authority and current ownership are in [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md), [CLAUDE.md](../../CLAUDE.md),
the [one design/plan](../../docs/design/ONE_DESIGN_PLAN.md), its [ledger](../../docs/design/one-design-plan.json),
and [coordination record](../../.design/claude-convergence/COORDINATION.md). Read those existing owners for the applicable rules and scope.

For Codespace startup, continuation, troubleshooting and demonstration paths, read the existing
[Codespace agent playbook](../../docs/getting-started/CODESPACE_AGENT_PLAYBOOK.md). The running app is managed by
[post-create](../../.devcontainer/post-create.sh), [post-start](../../.devcontainer/post-start.sh) and the existing
[Codespaces doctor](../../scripts/ops/codespaces-doctor.mjs). Local editor observations belong in the existing
[human-testing handoff](../../docs/testing/CODESPACES_EDITOR_HUMAN_TESTING_2026-10-14.md).

The relevant source and evidence already exist:

- [Project and Vault demo examples](../../docs/evidence/DEMO/2026-11-13-project-vault-examples/README.md): eight native CSR stages, populated project folders and the completed internal synthetic handover. The existing [portfolio seed](../../scripts/demo/launch-demo/packs/portfolio.mjs) owns these examples.
- [Codespace document runtime](../../docs/evidence/F1/2026-11-13-codespaces-docx-runtime/README.md): setup, readiness and provider-free document verification.
- [Retained archived projects](../../docs/evidence/F1/2026-11-13-archived-project-open/README.md): the existing Open and separate Restore actions.
- [Saved-section drafting](../../docs/evidence/F1/2026-11-13-editor-section-draft-currentness/README.md): current-section admission before the existing editor-to-AnA handoff.
- [Browser workflow receipts](../../docs/evidence/F1/2026-11-13-tier5-current-workflows/README.md): the scope and limits of the running-app browser observations.

Use the current checked-out implementation and each receipt's stated source/runtime limits when continuing work.
An internal demonstration package, an automated test, a live model answer and scientific approval are separate recorded outcomes.
